violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: equipment, dishes washed, rinsed, and sanitized at dish machine operating at 152-153F.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. Employee washed, rinsed, and sanitized all equipment at 3 compartment sink.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed cooked broccolini (75F) in 4 door prep.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Item discarded.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition

violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed microgreens (69F) on counter; pickled Fresno chili, baby kale (47-48F), queso fresco (47F) in 2 DR prep (R) at cookline; cooked Carlin (58F) in 2 DR flat (L) at cookline.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating and drinking in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. PIC trained all staff on proper locations of eating and drinking in establishment. PIC placed all open drink containers in designated storage to prevent the contamination of food and food contact surfaces.

violations.observation: The date when the last shellstock (mussels) from the container is sold or served is not recorded on the tag or label.
